cues._: Seconds on the ad timeline. beat = 60/118 BPM; drop = the score's energy arrival; b(k) = drop + k*beat. The scene derives every micro-timing from these.

audio._: music_edit.mp3 is audio/music.mp3 with two beat-aligned cuts so the score's full-energy section fits an 18 s ad: orig 7.356 to 11.389 s (8 beats, 2 bars) and orig 20.067 to 21.048 s (2 beats) are removed, each with a 35 ms equal-power cross-fade inside a pre-kick gap, chords stay on the 2-beat grid. Without the edit the logo hit would land at 17.6 s and the ad would run about 24 s. music_offset is into the edited file (the file is identical to music.mp3 up to the first cut).
